skill_name: How can you use a GPT-2 model to generate text?
workflow: A GPT-2 model can be used to generate text by taking a prompt as input and then predicting the next word or words that should follow in the text. The model can be trained on large datasets of text and uses a technique known as self-attention, which takes into account the entire context of a sentence before predicting the next word.
